findings.issue: TC-E5-009-07 and TC-E5-009-08 are each used twice in section 16; the contract and 12.7 rows duplicate the AC5 and AC6 rows.
The new TC rows put the category in Covers and the AC in Data, so the lint finds no row covering AC5 to AC17 (13 findings).
New TC rows were inserted before TC-E5-009-06, so the legacy rows are no longer in order in section 16.
AC16 never names 401 or 403, repeats AC5's role refusal and its title mixes in the wrong-state case that AC15 owns.
AC15's Given drops the second 'not', so it can be read as refusing a case that is in FIRM_ESCALATED.
X3's covered-by still lists only AC2, AC3; the new AC15 tagged X3 is missing.
X8's covered-by still lists only AC2, AC3; the new AC13 and AC14 tagged X8 are missing.
The BR7 coverage line omits AC17 and TC-E5-009-19 even though AC17 is tagged BR7.
The note after the criteria explains AC5 to AC12 but not the added AC13 to AC17.
Marked Not applied, but MSG-P1-001 is now the Error and Message Standard v4 wording (R-27134), so the message item is resolved.
The disposition section field holds the stray text 'find it' instead of a section number.
